data_spec.unit: percentage share of US total soybean use
data_spec.denominator: Total soybean use by US marketing year
data_spec.provenance: reported for original values; derived for computed historical values
data_spec.source_details: McKinsey Agriculture Industry Review 2026-11-11, citing underlying US soybean supply and use projections; detailed source in article notes.

data_recipe: Confirm common soybean-use denominator and marketing-year conventions.
Extract use shares per category from official cited sources.
Derive earlier shares only when the stated period and percentage-point changes match.
Separate domestic processing and exports without assuming they exhaust total use.
Render grouped bars with unit, year, and reported/derived provenance.
message_conditions: Both series use share of total US soybean use, not production or crop acreage.
Two-year baseline derived using explicitly stated five percentage-point changes.
design_moves: Zero baseline and no synthetic values.
Direct value labels and documented emphasis.
Source and neutral themes via config.json.
limitations: Other soybean uses are omitted; the two percentages do not add to 100%.
Underlying original vector exhibit inaccessible; fidelity cannot be scored.
Published text may round reported changes, and inferred earlier values inherit that uncertainty.
diff_notes: Grouped bars are editorial; original chart not visually verified.
2024/25 shares derived from prose stating five percentage-point changes over two years.
Crush and export do not sum to 100%; other uses intentionally omitted.

training_pair.instruction: Use the public data in data.csv and design rules in config.json to render grouped_share; preserve reported/derived provenance and disclose limitations.
training_pair.response: Install requirements.txt, then run: python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png ; rerun --theme neutral --output neutral.png. The exact observed inputs and style mapping are in data.csv and config.json.
